caption: The drawing consists of two rectangular sections connected by decorative lines, rendered entirely in black ink on an off-white background. The larger section, located in the lower left, depicts a wrought iron fence with decorative finials, a square brick pillar, and part of a house facade in the background, where horizontal siding, a window, and an external staircase are visible. A geometric, Greek-key pattern adorns the lower part of the fence. The upper right section is a smaller inset drawing, outlined with ornate linear borders, showing a single-story house with a porch, four visible columns, a pedimented gable over the entrance, and several window openings. A short, stepped path leads from a similar iron gate to the porch, and foliage or trees are depicted to the right. At the bottom right of the image, inside a decorated cartouche, is the text "Beauregard House" written in stylized script. All elements are composed with precise line work and crosshatching for shading.
title: Cast Iron Fence
